slides.types: a film · a book · a restaurant · an app · a place
slides.say: A review answers one question for the reader: should I try it, or not? A film, a book, a restaurant, an app, a place. It has four paragraphs. Introduce it. Describe one feature, then another. And recommend it, or warn people off. One hundred and forty to one hundred and ninety words.

slides.head: A · Catch the reader
opts: Choosing a … can be a real challenge. However, … is certainly an option worth considering.
When it comes to choosing a …, the number of options can be overwhelming. Nevertheless, … stands out as a great choice.
If you are looking for a …, then … could be the perfect option for you.
… might just be the ideal … you have been searching for.
Selecting the right … is never easy, but … definitely deserves your attention.
slides.line: Choosing a … can be a real challenge. However, … is certainly an option worth considering.
slides.say: Paragraph one. Column A: catch the reader. Roll through the openers, and pick one. Choosing a restaurant can be a real challenge. However, Café Azul is certainly an option worth considering.

slides.head: B · Introduce it
opts: Known / famous for its …, … has been a favourite among tourists / teenagers / shoppers.
Located in / Designed by / Built in …, it remains an emblematic … .
Regarded as / Considered one of the best / the most …, few … can rival / compete with it.
By far one of the best / the most … is …
slides.line: Known for its …, … has been a favourite among teenagers.
slides.tip: Name it in the first two lines.
slides.say: Then column B: introduce it. Known for its homemade cakes, it has been a favourite among teenagers. Name it in the first two lines, and keep writing about it to the end.

slides.head: Name it · describe it
opts: The thing that is most likely to impress you is …
The other feature which I found most impressive is …
If you happen to appreciate …, … is by far the most … I have …
Anyone interested in … will be especially impressed by …
By far the best feature … / the most appealing aspect of … is …
fills: the food, which is absolutely mouth-watering.
slides.say: Paragraphs two and three: one feature each. Name the feature, then describe it. What impressed me most was the food, which is absolutely mouth-watering.

slides.head: Then add one or two
lines: This is because everything is made fresh.
For instance, the banana cake is still warm.
The only drawback is that it gets crowded.
slides.say: Then add one or two of these. A reason: this is because everything is made fresh. An example: for instance, the banana cake is still warm. And one negative: the only drawback is that it gets crowded. It makes your praise believable.

slides.head: Should I go?
opts: I guarantee that … will not disappoint anyone who is seeking / looking for …
This is a … which you cannot afford to miss for its …
For anyone who is interested in …, … is a must.
I can assure you that … will leave a lasting impression on you.
slides.line: For anyone who is interested in …, … is a must.
slides.say: Last paragraph: answer the reader's question. Should I go? Roll the recommendations and pick one. For anyone who is interested in good coffee, Café Azul is a must.
Never add a new feature here. And never end with: that's all, thank you for reading.
Now open the cards. Roll, pick, and fill.
